newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mostly higher.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended mostly higher on Wednesday recovering from earlier losses due to technical buying from local investors, traders said.
Prices ranged from 20 yen lower to 70 yen higher, with the benchmark May 1998 contract closing 70 yen up at 14,520 yen.
The day's estimated volume was 32,946 lots.
Traders said most contracts eased in early trade, due to the yen's firmer tendency against the dollar but that prices later rose on technical buying by local investors particularly in distant months.
The spot July corn contract on the CBOT Project A overnight trading system stood at $2.76-1/4 per bushel at 0840 GMT, down from $2.77-1/2 at Tuesday's close.
Spot July CBOT soybean futures were trading at $8.54-1/4 a bushel at 0840 GMT, against $8.60 at Tuesday's close.
